card.name: End of heading before preparation steps
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a heading end just before the first step of a how-to or preparation procedure, where an imperative verb like Add, Place, Obtain or Develop comes next.

modes.label: Drug preparation steps
modes.description: Closing parenthesis, colon or period after a heading about preparing a suspension or test, right before the first instruction.
modes.example: Preparation of Suspension (for 200 mL of a 2 mg/mL suspension<<)>> Add 50 mL of Pur

modes.label: Recipe or trick instructions
modes.description: Punctuation ending a lead-in sentence in a home remedy or card trick, before the instructions begin.
modes.example: To make a tinct<<ure>>: Blend equal parts of pipsisse

card.writes: It pushes the model to start the next sentence with an imperative verb such as Place, Put, Take or Fix.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a list of how-to steps is about to begin, so a command verb comes next.
